description: WMS review-sweep (issue #11/#17) visibility: open WorkUnit/Outcome backlog, the nightly sweep's disposition breakdown by rule id, day-by-day activity history (closed vs skipped, calendar-day buckets), the sweep-parked on_hold queue awaiting Stage 2, and freshness. See semantic-conventions.md §4.8 for the agent_id/rule-id grammar and the on_hold/abandoned reopen semantics.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_workunits FROM workunits WHERE status NOT IN ('done','abandoned')

panels.title: Open WorkUnits
panels.description: status NOT IN ('done','abandoned') — matches GetStatusSummary's Open bucket (internal/store/mysql/status.go, internal/store/sqlite/session.go): every non-done/non-abandoned status, including on_hold, counts as open.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_outcomes FROM outcomes WHERE status NOT IN ('done','abandoned')

panels.title: Open Outcomes
panels.description: status NOT IN ('done','abandoned') — matches GetStatusSummary's Open bucket. Same predicate as Open WorkUnits, outcomes table.

Hours since the last wms_journal row written by agent_id='wms-review-sweep' (either sweep stage). The nightly timer runs once every ~24h; green < 27h, yellow < 30h, red >= 30h (kit AC4: a sweep silent for >~30h should read as stale, not healthy).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(created_at), NOW()) / 60.0, 1) AS hours_since_sweep
FROM wms_journal
WHERE agent_id = 'wms-review-sweep'

panels.title: Last Review-Sweep Activity
Sweep Disposition — by Rule and by Day

panels.description: Every wms_journal row agent_id='wms-review-sweep' wrote on the sweep's most recent calendar day (DATE(created_at) bucketing, not a discrete run — several hand invocations on the same day, e.g. burn-in or a dry-run followed minutes later by a --confirm run, merge into this one bucket), grouped by the rule id that is always the first token of notes (WP3-DESIGN.md §4). Covers all eight rule ids across both Sweep Stage 1 (wu-review-undelivered, wu-review-delivered, wu-review-skipped, outcome-idle, outcome-idle-skipped) and Sweep Stage 2 (wu-onhold-abandon, outcome-onhold-abandon, onhold-evaluated-skipped) — not just closes, so a night that mostly parks/skips does not read as "no sweep activity."

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(notes, ' ', 1) AS rule_id, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM wms_journal
WHERE agent_id = 'wms-review-sweep'
  AND DATE(created_at) = (
        SELECT MAX(DATE(created_at)) FROM wms_journal WHERE agent_id = 'wms-review-sweep'
      )
GROUP BY rule_id
ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Sweep Activity by Rule (latest day)

panels.description: Grouped by calendar day (DATE(created_at)) -- same bucketing as the panel above, not a discrete-run history; multiple hand invocations on one day merge into a single row. closed counts field='status' rows whose new_value is on_hold, done, or abandoned — every real disposition Sweep Stage 1 or Stage 2 can write, not just 'done' (a done-only filter undercounts by construction: parks and abandons are the more common dispositions). skipped counts field='sweep_evaluated' AND new_value='skipped' rows (all three skip rule ids share this shape).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(created_at) AS run_day,
  SUM(CASE WHEN field = 'status' AND new_value IN ('on_hold','done','abandoned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN field = 'sweep_evaluated' AND new_value = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped
FROM wms_journal
WHERE agent_id = 'wms-review-sweep'
GROUP BY run_day
ORDER BY run_day DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Sweep Activity History (by day)

panels.description: Entities currently on_hold whose latest field='status' wms_journal row was written by agent_id='wms-review-sweep' -- i.e. the sweep parked them, not a human (semantic-conventions.md §4.8; WP3-DESIGN.md §2b's own discriminator, same shape). A human-set on_hold entity's latest status row has a different agent_id (or empty) and is correctly excluded -- it is never at risk of Stage 2 and this dashboard must not suggest otherwise (WP3-DESIGN.md §3a). idle_days is days since the parking row, for comparison against whatever ReviewSweep.AbandonAfter is configured to on this install; sorted oldest-parked first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT entity_type, entity_id, title, rule_id, parked_at,
       DATEDIFF(NOW(), parked_at) AS idle_days
FROM (
  SELECT 'workunit' AS entity_type, w.id AS entity_id, w.title AS title,
         (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(j.notes, ' ', 1) FROM wms_journal j
            WHERE j.entity_type = 'workunit' AND j.entity_id = w.id AND j.field = 'status'
            ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS rule_id,
         (SELECT j.created_at FROM wms_journal j
            WHERE j.entity_type = 'workunit' AND j.entity_id = w.id AND j.field = 'status'
            ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS parked_at
  FROM workunits w
  WHERE w.status = 'on_hold'
    AND (SELECT j.agent_id FROM wms_journal j
           WHERE j.entity_type = 'workunit' AND j.entity_id = w.id AND j.field = 'status'
           ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1) = 'wms-review-sweep'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'outcome' AS entity_type, o.id AS entity_id, o.title AS title,
         (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(j.notes, ' ', 1) FROM wms_journal j
            WHERE j.entity_type = 'outcome' AND j.entity_id = o.id AND j.field = 'status'
            ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS rule_id,
         (SELECT j.created_at FROM wms_journal j
            WHERE j.entity_type = 'outcome' AND j.entity_id = o.id AND j.field = 'status'
            ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS parked_at
  FROM outcomes o
  WHERE o.status = 'on_hold'
    AND (SELECT j.agent_id FROM wms_journal j
           WHERE j.entity_type = 'outcome' AND j.entity_id = o.id AND j.field = 'status'
           ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1) = 'wms-review-sweep'
) sweep_parked
ORDER BY idle_days DESC

panels.title: Sweep-Parked Entities Awaiting Stage 2
Reopen Semantics — What This Dashboard's Numbers Do and Don't Mean

options.content:
A **`wu-review-delivered`** close (`review → done`, tagged `resolution: swept-unreviewed`) **is** reopenable — `done → review` is a real, standing edge, so a human can walk it back at any time.

A **Sweep Stage 2 abandon** (`on_hold → abandoned`, rule `wu-onhold-abandon` or `outcome-onhold-abandon`) **is not** reopenable by any MCP call. `abandoned` is a strict one-way status with no outbound edge in `transitions.go`. Recovering a wrongly-abandoned entity is a manual database fix (`UPDATE ... SET status = 'review' WHERE status = 'abandoned'`, plus a corrective journal row written by hand) — see `semantic-conventions.md` §4.3/§4.8 and `WP3-DESIGN.md` §3a. A `wu-review-undelivered` or `outcome-idle` park to `on_hold` is fully reversible with an ordinary status-update call and carries no such risk — only what actually reaches `abandoned` is a one-way door.
